label: Replace Content
description: Replaces one child of the item this step works on (the one an earlier step created, or else the one this request is about) with the content the request gives. A request giving none removes the child.

child.label: Child to replace
child.description: The name of the child replaced, e.g. "cond:condition".

nodeTypes.label: Node types
nodeTypes.description: The types of content the replacement may hold, including their subtypes.
